input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: There is no most-favoured-nation language anywhere in the Agreement, and in particular no obligation on Sparkling to extend Garman terms as good as those given to third parties. Nothing to redline (Schedule A pricing was not provided and will be checked for MFN language).

input.quote: both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement
input.rationale: This is a no-hire, not a non-solicit, and on its face it captures "any employee of the other party" rather than only personnel involved in the services, with no carve-out for general advertising or unsolicited approaches — no-hire provisions are walk-away territory under our playbook. We narrowed it to a mutual 12-month non-solicitation of directly involved personnel with the standard carve-outs; mutuality is preserved.

input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Sparkling has an unqualified convenience right on 90 days' notice with no early-termination fee or penalty, and Garman has no convenience right at all (it may terminate only for insolvency or uncured material default). This sits at the fallback (90 rather than 30 days); we note only that there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid maintenance fees on a convenience exit, which we would add if the document is reopened.

input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services
input.rationale: There is no automatic renewal and no non-renewal notice window: the licence is perpetual while fees are paid and maintenance runs in renewable one-year terms, i.e. renewal is effectively by agreement and payment, which meets the preferred position. We note only that no cap on renewal-year maintenance price increases appears in the body of the Agreement (Schedule A not provided); we would add a CPI/3% cap if reopened.
